messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Hey team! Taylor here, starting as Product Designer on onboarding. Quick list: Figma access, which files to skim first, design critique cadence, and where research notes live. Any pro-tips?
Ivy (DesignOps): Welcome Taylor :tada: Which email did you sign up with? I'll invite you to the Design org and the critique calendar. We run design crits every Tue 10:30am, optional but encouraged.
Taylor Nguyen: taylor.nguyen@redwood.com. Thanks! Also: do we use any Figma plugins centrally (like Tokens, FigJam templates)?
Rafi_IT: Okta should have provisioned you. If Figma invite not in inbox try https://okta.redwood.com/apps -> Request Access -> Figma. I also pushed access for the "Redwood Design Plugins" team so you should see Tokens and Accessibility Check plugins.
Ivy (DesignOps): Sent invites to Figma and Notion. Start with these files: 1) "Onboarding - Patterns (library)", 2) "Signup + Activation flows (current sprint)", 3) "Design Crits / Archive" (past critiques). Accept the library to get tokens.
Sana (Research): Research lives in Dovetail (raw) and Notion (synths). We have an "Onboarding research index" Notion page with links to Dovetail projects and TL;DRs. For tests, please add a 2-sentence summary + 3 action bullets.
Ben (PM): Roadmap is Product > Roadmap (Notion). There's a short onboarding brief with KPIs and open questions. If you want, I can do a 15m rundown tomorrow at 11am.
Taylor Nguyen: 11am works. One more: critique etiquette? Any templated feedback format we use?
Ivy (DesignOps): We use the "I saw / I think / I suggest" frame in crits. Keep feedback action-oriented and call out assumptions. Add the Figma link to the crit agenda doc before the meeting.
design-bot: Automated: added Taylor Nguyen to "Design" Figma org and subscribed them to #design-crits calendar.
Taylor Nguyen: Got the invites and opened the files. I'll book the 11am sync and drop my prototype in the crit agenda. Appreciate the quick help! :raised_hands:
